en.text:
We~27re partners in our

E dai~2c non essere titubante!

with me?

fr.text:
Alors~2c je t~27en prie!

Dai~2c ti prego in ginocchio.

$n0~2c tú y yo

en.text:
$n0~2c with you~2c
I think we could even become the world~27s

$n0~2c ich denke~2c
wir beide könnten das beste Retterteam

$n0~2c penso che io e
te potremmo diventare la miglior

$n0~2c tú y yo

en.text:
I think we could become
the world~27s number-one rescue team~2c
$n0. What do you think?

Ich bin überzeugt~2c wir

fr.text:
Je pense qu~27on pourrait
devenir la meilleure équipe de secours au
monde~2c $n0. Qu~27en dis-tu?

$n0. Che ne dici?

el equipo más famoso del mundo~2c
$n0. ¿Qué dices?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
$n0~2c I think we~27d
make the world~27s greatest rescue team.

de.text:
$n0~2c wir werden

das es jemals gegeben hat. Bist du dabei?

fr.text:
$n0~2c je pense qu~27on
formerait la meilleure équipe de secours
au monde. Qu~27en penses-tu?

$n0~2c credo che
potremmo diventare la miglior

en.text:
Would you like to join me
on a rescue team?

de.text:
Hast du nicht Lust~2c mit
mir ein Retterteam aufzubauen?

fr.text:
Voudrais-tu te joindre à moi
pour former une équipe de secours?

it.text:
Ti piacerebbe unirti a me e
formare una Squadra di Soccorso?

es.text:
¿Querrías formar un equipo
de rescate conmigo?

en.text:
So~2c uh...#W
Well~2c I liked how you handled yourself
when we rescued $n2.

de.text:
Daher~2c äh... #W Nun~2c
mir hat gefallen~2c wie du mir bei der
Rettung von $n2 geholfen hast.

fr.text:
Alors~2c euh...#W
Eh bien~2c j~27ai aimé ta façon de réagir
pendant le sauvetage de $n2.

it.text:
E così...#W
Sai~2c mi è piaciuto il tuo modo di agire
quando abbiamo salvato $n2.

es.text:
Y~2c en fin...#W
No lo hiciste mal del todo
cuando salvamos a $n2.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
I want to help change things
so all the Pokémon can live in peace.

de.text:
Ich möchte die Dinge
ändern~2c sodass alle Pokémon friedlich
leben können.

fr.text:
Je veux faire en sorte que
tous les Pokémon vivent en paix.

it.text:
Voglio fare in modo che le
cose cambino~2c così i Pokémon potranno
vivere in pace.

es.text:
Quiero cambiar las cosas y
que los Pokémon vivan en paz.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
I want to help Pokémon in
these tough times.

de.text:
Ich möchte den Pokémon
in diesen schweren Zeiten helfen.

fr.text:
Je veux aider les Pokémon
à surmonter ces difficultés.

it.text:
Io voglio essere d~27aiuto a
questi Pokémon nel momento del bisogno.

es.text:
Quiero ayudar a los demás
Pokémon ahora que más lo necesitan.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
Because of those disasters~2c
many Pokémon are suffering.

de.text:
Und aufgrund dieser
Katastrophen leiden viele Pokémon.

fr.text:
A cause de ces
catastrophes~2c beaucoup de Pokémon ont
besoin d~27aide.

it.text:
A causa di queste catastrofi
naturali~2c molti Pokémon si trovano
in difficoltà.

es.text:
Muchos Pokémon son
víctimas de esos desastres naturales.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
For some reason~2c there have
been many natural disasters lately.

de.text:
Aus irgendeinem Grund
häufen sich in letzter Zeit die
Naturkatastrophen.

fr.text:
Pour une raison inconnue~2c
il y a eu de nombreuses catastrophes
naturelles du même ordre récemment.

it.text:
Per qualche ragione~2c di
recente sono successe molte cose
del genere.

es.text:
Por algún motivo que
desconocemos~2c últimamente ocurren
más y más calamidades...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
You know~2c just like the
fissure $n2 fell into...

de.text:
Genau wie diese Erdspalte~2c
in die $n2 gefallen ist...

fr.text:
Tu te souviens de la
crevasse dans laquelle $n2 a
chuté?

it.text:
Ti ricordi della voragine
in cui è caduto $n2...

es.text:
Ya sabes~2c como cuando
$n2 tuvo ese accidente...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
Would you like to form
a rescue team with me?

de.text:
Hättest du vielleicht Lust~2c
ein Retterteam mit mir zu gründen?

fr.text:
Voudrais-tu qu~27on crée une
équipe de secours ensemble?

it.text:
Che ne dici di formare una
Squadra di Soccorso con me?

es.text:
¿No querrías formar un
equipo de rescate conmigo?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
So~2c um...#W
Well~2c I saw how good you were when
we rescued $n2...

de.text:
Also~2c äh...#W
Ich habe gesehen~2c wie gut du warst~2c
als wir $n2 gerettet haben...

fr.text:
Alors~2c hum...#W Eh bien~2c j~27ai
pu voir comme tu te débrouillais bien
quand on a secouru $n2...

it.text:
E quindi...#W
Sai~2c ho ammirato la tua abilità quando
abbiamo salvato $n2...

es.text:
Esto...#W
Bueno~2c ya vi cómo trabajabas
cuando rescatamos a $n2...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

en.text:
I want to help make the
world a safer place for Pokémon.

de.text:
Ich möchte aus dieser Welt
einen sicheren Ort für Pokémon machen.

fr.text:
Je veux que les Pokémon
puissent se sentir en sécurité.

it.text:
Voglio contribuire a rendere
